prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Phoenix. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — but first a quick question: do you want practices in a specific part of Phoenix (zip code or neighborhood), do you have dental insurance, and is this for a single implant or a more complex/full-arch case? With that I’ll give a short, tailored list of offices to call plus why each is a good fit.

Meanwhile, here’s the fastest way to get good candidates right away (and which types of practices to call and why):

Which practices to call (types) and why
- Board‑certified oral & maxillofacial surgeon
  - Why: these specialists perform implant surgery, bone grafts and extractions, and offer sedation/general anesthesia for anxious patients or complex cases.
- Board‑certified periodontist (implant specialist)
  - Why: focused on the gums and bone support for implants; excellent for patients who need bone grafting or sinus lifts.
- Prosthodontist (restorative specialist)
  - Why: ideal for complex restorations or full‑arch implant cases — they design and place the implant crowns/bridges for best function and esthetics.
- Implant center or multidisciplinary practice
  - Why: they coordinate both surgery and final restoration in one place and often use CBCT 3D imaging and guided surgical planning.
- General dentist with advanced implant training
  - Why: many general dentists handle straightforward single implants and restorations; can be more convenient and cost‑effective for simple cases.

What to ask when you call (quick checklist)
- Are you board certified? How many implants do you place per year?
- Who will do the surgery and who will do the crown/restoration?
- Do you use CBCT 3D imaging and guided implant planning?
- Which implant systems do you use (Straumann, Nobel, Zimmer, etc.)?
- Do you perform bone grafts/sinus lifts in‑house?
- Sedation options and cost (IV, oral, nitrous)?
- Estimated total cost for my case and whether you offer financing or payment plans
- Warranty/guarantee and follow‑up schedule
- Can I see before/after photos or patient references?

If you want, give your zip code/neighborhood and whether you have insurance (and the plan name). I’ll return 4–6 specific Phoenix‑area practices (oral surgeon, periodontist, prosthodontist or multidisciplinary implant center, and a general dentist who does implants) with a short reason for each one to call.
